================================================================================
  Figure Panel  : S6E
  Description   : Permutation-based significance testing of the association
                  between DNA methylation scores and gene expression in the
                  retrospective COLOSSUS cohort. Generates null distribution
                  of correlation coefficients by random permutation of sample
                  labels and compares to observed correlation.
  Input data    : Retrospective COLOSSUS methylation score matrix
                  Retrospective COLOSSUS RNA-seq expression matrix
  Output        : S6E_permutation_distribution_plot.pdf

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# -------------------------------
# Input: expression matrix and gene list
# -------------------------------

# expression_data: a data frame or matrix with genes as rows and samples as columns
# rownames(expression_data) = gene symbols or Ensembl IDs
# hypomethylated_genes: a character vector of gene symbols or Ensembl IDs

# Example placeholders (replace with your actual data)
# expression_data <- read.csv("expression_matrix.csv", row.names = 1)
# hypomethylated_genes <- readLines("hypomethylated_genes.txt")

# For demonstration, simulate some expression data
set.seed(42)
expression_data <- read.delim("20260418_20200705_COLOSSUS - Task 4.1-RNA Lexogen_retrospective cohort_June2020_Exp_data_names_corrected_DESeq2_VST_filtered_1M_reads_percent_3_5_Combat_Centre_Lane_1M_reads_batches_corrected_no_reads_involved.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = 1)

# Hypomethylated genes (example subset)
hypomethylated_genes <- read.delim("getPair.hypo.pairs.significant_with_correlation_Anguraj_-0.2_correlation_2000_removed.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

hypomethylated_genes <- unique(hypomethylated_genes$Symbol)

# -------------------------------
# Compute median expression per gene
# -------------------------------
gene_medians <- apply(expression_data, 1, median)

# Filter for genes in expression data
hypo_genes_in_data <- hypomethylated_genes[hypomethylated_genes %in% names(gene_medians)]
background_genes <- setdiff(names(gene_medians), hypo_genes_in_data)

# Sample same number of genes from background
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
random_genes <- sample(background_genes, length(hypo_genes_in_data))

# Create data frame for plotting
expression_df <- data.frame(
  Gene = c(hypo_genes_in_data, random_genes),
  MedianExpression = c(gene_medians[hypo_genes_in_data], gene_medians[random_genes]),
  Group = rep(c("Hypomethylated", "Random Background"), each = length(hypo_genes_in_data))
)

# -------------------------------
# Wilcoxon rank-sum test
# -------------------------------
wilcox_test <- wilcox.test(
  MedianExpression ~ Group,
  data = expression_df,
  alternative = "greater"  # test if hypomethylated > random
)

# Print p-value
cat("Wilcoxon test p-value:", wilcox_test$p.value, "\n")

# -------------------------------
# Visualization
# -------------------------------
#pdf("20251120_20200830_COLOSSUS - Task 4.1-RNA Lexogen_retrospective cohort_June2020_Exp_data_sd0_DESeq2_rlog_filtered_5_ALL_Combat_6_batches_corrected_hypomethylation_compared_to_random_background.pdf")
ggplot(expression_df, aes(x = Group, y = MedianExpression, fill = Group)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Expression of Hypomethylated Genes vs. Random Genes",
    subtitle = paste("Wilcoxon p-value:", signif(wilcox_test$p.value, 3)),
    x = "",
    y = "Median Gene Expression"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
#dev.off()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# median expression per gene
gene_medians <- apply(expression_data, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)

# keep hypomethylated genes present in expression matrix
hypo_genes_in_data <- intersect(hypomethylated_genes, names(gene_medians))
n_hypo <- length(hypo_genes_in_data)

background_genes <- setdiff(names(gene_medians), hypo_genes_in_data)

# observed statistic
obs_median <- median(gene_medians[hypo_genes_in_data], na.rm = TRUE)

# permutation / resampling
set.seed(123)
n_perm <- 1000

perm_medians <- replicate(n_perm, {
  rand_genes <- sample(background_genes, n_hypo)
  median(gene_medians[rand_genes], na.rm = TRUE)
})

# empirical p-value
empirical_p <- (sum(perm_medians >= obs_median) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)

cat("Observed median:", obs_median, "\n")
cat("Empirical p-value:", empirical_p, "\n")

plot_df <- data.frame(
  MedianExpression = c(perm_medians, obs_median),
  Group = c(rep("Random gene sets", n_perm), "Hypomethylated gene set")
)

pdf("S6E_20260507_COLOSSUS_gene_exp_methy_permutation_violin_plot.pdf",
    width = 8, height = 6)
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Group, y = MedianExpression, fill = Group)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(plot_df, Group == "Hypomethylated gene set"),
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Expression of hypomethylated genes relative to random gene sets",
    subtitle = paste0("Empirical p = ", signif(empirical_p, 3)),
    x = "",
    y = "Median gene expression"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
dev.off()

```



```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Expression matrix
expression_data <- read.delim(
  "20260418_20200705_COLOSSUS - Task 4.1-RNA Lexogen_retrospective cohort_June2020_Exp_data_names_corrected_DESeq2_VST_filtered_1M_reads_percent_3_5_Combat_Centre_Lane_1M_reads_batches_corrected_no_reads_involved.txt",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  row.names = 1
)

# Hypomethylated genes
hypo_df <- read.delim(
  "getPair.hypo.pairs.significant_with_correlation_Anguraj_-0.2_correlation.txt",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

hypomethylated_genes <- unique(hypo_df$Symbol)

# Gene-level median expression
gene_medians <- apply(expression_data, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)

# Retain overlapping genes
hypo_genes_in_data <- intersect(hypomethylated_genes, names(gene_medians))
background_genes <- setdiff(names(gene_medians), hypo_genes_in_data)
n_hypo <- length(hypo_genes_in_data)

if (n_hypo == 0) stop("No hypomethylated genes overlap with the expression matrix.")

# Observed statistic
obs_median <- median(gene_medians[hypo_genes_in_data], na.rm = TRUE)

# Permutation-based background modelling
set.seed(123)
n_perm <- 1000

perm_medians <- replicate(n_perm, {
  rand_genes <- sample(background_genes, n_hypo)
  median(gene_medians[rand_genes], na.rm = TRUE)
})

# Empirical p-value
empirical_p <- (sum(perm_medians >= obs_median) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)

cat("Number of hypomethylated genes in expression data:", n_hypo, "\n")
cat("Observed median expression:", obs_median, "\n")
cat("Empirical p-value:", empirical_p, "\n")

# Plot null distribution
df_resample <- data.frame(Median = perm_medians)

pdf("S6E_20260507_COLOSSUS_gene_exp_methy_permutation_histogram.pdf",
    width = 8, height = 6)

ggplot(df_resample, aes(x = Median)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = obs_median, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Expression of hypomethylated genes relative to random gene sets",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Observed median = ", round(obs_median, 3),
      " | Empirical p = ", signif(empirical_p, 3)
    ),
    x = "Median expression of random gene sets",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

dev.off()
```
